blockers.wanted: read the creak's pitch contour numerically (200-1500 Hz, moving)
blockers.tried: listen 'pitch by tenth' and YIN pitch
blockers.workaround: read the spectrogram PNG ridge by eye (rises ~280 -> 500 Hz in 0.6 s, then ~500 -> 1100 Hz); friction fundamental = speed*grain so the ramp values are the contour

blockers.wanted: a 'ring' (decay up) and a 'weight' (modal size, centroid down) knob
blockers.tried: modal loss -> decay claim; modal size -> centroid claim
blockers.workaround: dropped both; used a lowpass freq macro 'muffling' (centroid -1), 'shrillness' (ramp from/to, centroid +1) and 'rust' (friction roughness, flatness +1)

blockers.wanted: stick-slip creak with a steady level
blockers.tried: friction through modal wood size 0.45 mixed with raw friction
blockers.workaround: modal resonance at ~520 Hz makes a ~12 dB louder bump at 0.5 s as the sweep crosses it (peak at 0.52 s, then level falls to the end); accepted, loss 2.5 to damp it

wishlist: a loudness-normalised or pitch-contour readout (ridge tracker) for gliding tones
decay/length claim usable for driven sounds (measure from the end of the drive, or a 'duration' claim)
calls file option to stop at first failure
what_worked: friction speed * grain gives the pitch directly: a ramp on speed is the contour
verify macro sweeps caught two bad claims at once with the measured values
listen spectrogram image shows the gliding line clearly
